prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” HVAC company that’s right for every Phoenix homeowner — the best choice depends on your exact location, system type, urgency, budget and whether you want same‑day emergency service vs. a planned repair or replacement.

I can help you pick the right contractor — but first a few quick questions:
- Is this for a home or a business?
- What neighborhood or ZIP code in Phoenix are you in?
- Is it an emergency (no cooling at all) or a non‑urgent repair?
- Do you know the AC brand/model and approximate age?

How to choose the best company (quick checklist)
- Licensing and insurance: Make sure they have an Arizona ROC license (commercial/residential as required) and general liability insurance.
- Certifications: Look for technicians who are NATE‑certified or factory trained on your brand.
- Local reputation: Read recent Google and Yelp reviews and check the BBB for patterns of complaints.
- Written estimate: Get a written, itemized estimate before work begins (parts, labor, warranties).
- Warranty & parts: Ask what labor and part warranties they provide and whether they honor manufacturer warranties.
- Upfront pricing: Ask whether they charge a diagnostic/service fee and how it’s applied if you proceed.
- Emergency availability: If you need immediate service, confirm same‑day/evening weekend options.
- Permits: For major repairs/replacements, confirm they’ll pull required city permits.
- References: Ask for recent local references or examples of similar work.

Questions to ask a contractor when you call
- Are you licensed in Arizona and insured? What’s your ROC number?
- Are your technicians NATE‑certified or factory trained for my brand?
- What’s the diagnose (service) fee and is it applied to repairs?
- Can you give an itemized written estimate before starting?
- What warranties do you offer on parts and labor?
- Do you handle permits and rebates?

If you want, give me your ZIP code and whether it’s urgent and I’ll list a few highly‑rated Phoenix contractors (and what to expect for pricing and timing).
